text:
Vlad: Quick sync — we need a coordinated version pin across api, runtime, console, and sdk for 0.30.0. Cutoff = Wed 18:00 PST. If your repo needs a chore PR, open it and tag @eng-releases. I'll collate changelog lines.

Emma: Opening chore PRs for api + sdk now. Will tag reviewers and run the verifier after push. ETA tomorrow morning.

Harper: Runtime heads-up: 0.30.0 changes a response-metadata header that adapters surface. I'm working on a small compatibility shim for runtime_adapter with unit tests — should be a 1-file patch. cc @Sam

Sam: Console only needs a tiny CSS fix for the model list overflow. Not a blocker for pin but I'll add a changelog fragment and open the PR.

Emma: Two quick asks for everyone:
1) Add a one-line changelog fragment under docs/changelogs/0.30.0.md in your repo.
2) Run locally or rely on CI: ```./tools/verify-pins --expected 0.30.0``` — checks package.json / pyproject.toml / go.mod pins across branches.

deploy-bot: scheduled gate run for 1777795200 (UTC). Will post pass/fail + failing files here.

Harper: Shim PR: https://git.example/repo/runtime/pull/1001 — compatibility shim for header + tests. Please prioritize review if you touch runtime_adapter.

Emma: PRs (WIP):
- api: https://git.example/repo/api/pull/721
- sdk: https://git.example/repo/sdk/pull/412
- console: https://git.example/repo/console/pull/154
Marked reviewers on each. I'll add changelog lines shortly.

deploy-bot: CI status: api passing, sdk failing lint. @Emma please run `pre-commit` and push.

Emma: Fixed lint, pushed. Retrying CI now.

deploy-bot: CI: all green for api, sdk, console, runtime PRs referenced. Gate run will execute at scheduled time and post results.

Vlad: Fallback plan if the shim doesn't land in time: cut 0.30.0 to Hosted canary only (15% traffic, 20m window), keep Dedicated on 0.29.x until adapters are fixed. Canary auto-fallback -> 0.29.x on elevated errors. Not ideal but acceptable as a fallback.

Harper: Understood. Will prioritize reviews — tests passed locally but CI flaked once; trying to stabilize.

Sam: Console changelog snippet added: "Fix: model list overflow". PR updated.

Emma: Gate run complete: PASS. No mismatched pins found. CI/linters green across the mentioned PRs.

Harper: Shim merged. All green.

Emma: Merged api + sdk PRs. Console merged as well.

Vlad: Rolling out canary 15% (20m). Monitor dashboards; rollback if error rate > 0.75%.

qa-bot: Monitoring hooks enabled. Will post alerts if regressions detected.

Vlad: If canary looks clean after 30m, promote to 50% then full. Thanks everyone :tada:
